reason: Somewhere indoors in Salisbury where my 4-year-old can play and my 10-month-old has her own gated spot, with me sitting down and a coffee, is something I'd actually use. The free first visit means I can see whether it's really calm before I pay.
objection: Will the bigger kids be running wild around my baby? A gated Baby Nook and limited numbers sound good on paper, but I need to see it on a real morning.
would_change_my_mind: If the free visit showed the Baby Nook was crowded or the older kids were loud and rough nearby, I'd drop it.
